narrative: Builders shipped 6,222 new Spaces this week, +2.3% against the week before, with every one of them classified (100.0% of 6,222). Chat and assistants remains the largest named use case at 974 Spaces (+7.7%), and the agent-shaped techniques behind it — agentic at 7.2% of Spaces and tool use at 3.8% — both gained ground. The audience mix tilted toward work: enterprise productivity picked up +0.8 points while education and healthcare both gave back share. On the model side 21,458 new models arrived, −0.8%, with NVIDIA's Nemotron family the one sharp mover.
